reflections.title: "He Who Began a Good Work"

reflect.text: When we come to faith, our walk with God is only just getting started. Becoming a Christian is not a one-time event that ends there, but a daily journey of growth. At first, we are like spiritual babies. We need to feed on God's Word, the Bible, and learn how to walk. Along the way, we often fall down and make mistakes. Yet we are not meant to stay weak or stagnant. We can depend on God's power every day to help us move forward.

As we walk with Him, God is actively working to mold our inner character to look like Jesus. He works like a master craftsman who shapes a piece of material against a perfect pattern, using Christ as the template for our lives. This growth can bring painful heat and friction when trials come, but God keeps us secure in His will. We can take deep comfort in knowing that we are His ongoing project, and He will finish what He started.

questions: Where are you feeling the heat or friction of God shaping your character right now?
How can knowing that God will finish His work help you when you stumble and make mistakes?
reflections.prayer: Father, thank You for beginning a good work in our hearts and promising to carry it through to completion. When we stumble or face painful trials, help us remember that we are held securely in Your hands. Please feed us through Your Word and shape our lives to be more like Jesus today. Amen.
